purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 10-record item effect batch 022; together these files contain exactly 10 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/portable-hole-124.name: Portable Hole
items/portable-hole-124.effectSummary: When spread on a surface, the 6-foot-diameter cloth opens a 10-foot-deep extradimensional space; folding the cloth closes the entrance while leaving its contents inside, and its carried weight does not increase when filled. The sealed space contains enough air for one Medium or two Small creatures for 10 minutes. Putting a bag of holding inside the hole tears a rift to the Astral Plane and destroys both items; putting the hole inside a bag of holding opens an Astral gate that draws in the bag, the hole, and creatures within 10 feet, destroying both items.

items/figurine-of-wondrous-power.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Pearlsteel Turtle)
items/figurine-of-wondrous-power.effectSummary: Tossing down the figurine and speaking its command word transforms it into a Huge giant sea turtle for up to 6 hours, usable three times per week. The turtle is CR 3 with 87 hp, AC 25, speed 20 feet, swim 30 feet, and a +13 bite dealing 1d8+3; it understands Common, serves as transport, will not attack on command, but defends itself if threatened. It can hold its breath for 1 hour, pull a boat or raft at up to half its swim speed, and can be ridden with a harness or improvised handholds; staying on its slick shell while moving requires a DC 20 Ride check each minute.

items/sextant-of-the-planes.name: Sextant of the Planes
items/sextant-of-the-planes.effectSummary: Unfolding or refolding the sextant takes 1 full round, and a reading takes 1 minute. A reading identifies the plane’s gravity, time flow, spatial form, morphic nature, dominant element or energy, alignment traits, magic traits, and any portals within 60 feet. It does not name the plane, but the user can attempt Knowledge (the planes) DC 18 to identify a matching plane. When used within 30 feet of a portal, it can instead report the same traits for the plane beyond and whether the portal is one-way or two-way.

items/annulus-704.name: Annulus
items/annulus-704.effectSummary: While grasped, the artifact immediately teaches its powers to the wielder and operates at manifester level 20. It continuously produces catapsi in a 100-foot radius without affecting the wielder and grants +4 enhancement on attempts to resist ability-damage effects; once per day it can use ultrablast, and three times per day it can create a 50-foot-radius psionic dimensional-anchor-like effect. Once per year, after 10 rounds of continuous concentration, it can completely disintegrate specified psionic targets within 100 feet regardless of protection; using this nullification against an exceptionally powerful being or another major artifact succeeds but destroys the Annulus permanently.

items/amulet-of-the-twelve-moons.name: Amulet of the Twelve Moons (Eberron)
items/amulet-of-the-twelve-moons.effectSummary: The amulet grants +2 enhancement on unarmed-strike and natural-weapon attack and damage rolls, increasing to +5 when all twelve moon stones are present. Its stones work concurrently: Zaranthyr gives immunity to wind and precipitation; Olarune +4 Wisdom; Therendor cure serious wounds 3/day or mass cure light wounds 1/day; Lyre +4 Craft; Dravago +5 Search and Survival and +5 wild empathy for druids/rangers; Nymm removes food/drink needs and reduces required sleep to 2 hours after one week of wear; Lharvion +4 Listen and Spot plus see invisibility 3/day; Barrakas discern location 1/day; Rhaan sending 3/day; Sypheros self-only displacement 3/day; Aryth dimension door 1/day; and Vult +4 natural armor AC. Spell effects operate at caster level 20 where specified.
